evidence.quote: For membrane fouling, a knowledge-based fuzzy broad learning (K-FBL) algorithm was de- veloped for early fouling warnings in wastewater treatment [134]. By integrating fuzzy rules derived from expert knowledge to com- pensate for data limitations, the K-FBL model outperformed con- ventional data-driven approaches, achieving high classification accuracy and robustness against incomplete data, offering a reli- able solution for fouling detection and prevention.
